amendments.because: The owner chose to keep the clash check but limit it to the default branch's new files, since CI already tested the pull request's own files
amendments.done_when: When CI is already green on the pull request's current commit, forge merge skips the laptop test run and goes straight to merging.

done_when: When the default branch moved after CI passed on the pull request's commit, forge merge runs on the laptop only the tests related to the files that changed on the default branch since that CI run, not the tests related to the pull request's own files
why: Each merge that finds the default branch moved reruns the related tests on the laptop's one test lane (src/forge/merge.py, the retest block with always=True), so busy days queue every merge behind near-full-suite runs even when CI already checked the pull request's commit.
